description: Claude Code ~/.claude/projects directory-name encoding vectors. POSIX rows marked captured=true were read from the `cwd` field inside real session JSONL files on a live macOS install and verified byte-for-byte against their directory names (encode(cwd) == dirName held for 26/27 sessions; the outlier was a JSONL copied across directories). Windows/UNC rows are modeled from the same algorithm (replace [^A-Za-z0-9] with '-') and are marked captured=false pending a real Windows capture in VAL-P0-PATH-022.

fixtures.note: Real macOS session cwd. Clean path — round-trips exactly.
Real macOS session cwd. `/.hermes` collapses to `--` (both `/` and `.` -> `-`); `hermes-agent` keeps its literal hyphen. Lossy: decode cannot tell `.` from `/` from `-`.
Real macOS session cwd (a /private/var temp dir). Mixed-case components preserved.
Modeled from the observed `Application Support` directory on macOS. Space -> `-`; lossy.
Modeled. Spaces and the `.` in `2.0` all become `-`; lossy.
PENDING VAL-P0-PATH-022. Modeled drive-prefixed form: drive `C`, then `:` and `\` both -> `-` giving `C--`.
PENDING VAL-P0-PATH-022. Non-C drive letter + a space in a component (`my project` -> `my-project`); lossy.
PENDING VAL-P0-PATH-022. Non-C drive letter + dots in a component (`App.2.0` -> `App-2-0`); lossy.
PENDING VAL-P0-PATH-022. UNC form: leading `\\` -> `--`. Ambiguous with a POSIX `/.fileserver/...` path when decoded under `.auto` — pass an explicit style to disambiguate.
PENDING VAL-P0-PATH-022. Non-ASCII: `é` is not [A-Za-z0-9] so it becomes `-` (`José` -> `Jos-`); destroyed by the encoding and unrecoverable on decode.
